context.exploration_scope: Extracted real improvement signals from the full 74-record canonical Experience Layer using E12's own exact grouping method (never a new threshold), checked against E12/E23/E33/S-series for duplication

problem: E12's pattern registry was intentionally left stale after analyzing only its first 12 Experience records; the Experience Layer has since grown to 74 records (E13..E51, S0..S18, SSI-S0), and it was unverified whether re-running E12's own method over the full set would surface real signals E12 never saw, or just re-confirm what it already found.

decision.decision_summary: 4 groups qualify under E12's count>=2 method. 2 are duplicates of E12's already-confirmed patterns (REJECTED). 2 are genuinely new, evidenced signals never previously registered (CANDIDATE_ONLY): sig_goal_project_brain_operational_successful_resolution (34 members), sig_goal_production_runtime_successful_resolution (3 members). 0 new rule/score/auto-learning, 0 real project modifications. Verdict: IMPROVEMENT_SIGNAL_FOUND.

action.action_summary: Re-ran E12's exact pattern-detection method over the full current Experience Layer; checked every qualifying group against E12's patterns, E23's principle, E33's candidates, and every real S-series candidate file for duplication; classified each as REJECTED or CANDIDATE_ONLY with real evidence_refs.

result.note: 2 genuinely new improvement signal(s) found and recorded as candidates only -- not applied, not auto-learned.

cause.root_cause_summary: E12's registry was correctly left stale by design (E12's own decision), but 'stale by design' does not mean 'never worth re-checking' -- re-running its exact method later, once real growth has occurred, is how a stale registry's coverage gap gets honestly measured rather than assumed away.

lesson: Re-applying an existing, already-validated detection method to a grown dataset is not the same as inventing a new one -- it is how a deliberately-stale registry gets checked for real coverage gaps without introducing any new scoring or learning mechanism.
